column3: Meet pixel pet. A tiny friend that lives above your Claude Code prompt.
It naps when things are quiet, and wakes up to read along as you type.
While Claude works, it tells you what's happening, and its little world scrolls by.
It groans when your tests fail, and cheers when they pass.
When Claude needs your OK, it waves you over.
Every subagent gets a tiny helper, and it keeps a calm eye on your limits.
Its world follows your day, from morning meadows to midnight on the moon.
Twenty eight colours, and hats for the season.
Pet it, and share its card.
pixel pet. One pet in every session. Free and open source, on GitHub.
